Based on the visual inspection of the time series plot, there is a distinct anomaly where the values drop significantly below the normal range (which fluctuates roughly between -5 and +5). This drop occurs towards the right side of the graph.

1.  **Start of anomaly:** The sharp drop begins just after the x-axis tick mark for 600. It looks to be around index 602 or 603.
2.  **End of anomaly:** The values return to the normal range abruptly at an index around 658 or 660.

Therefore, the detected range of anomalies is approximately [602, 659].

[[602, 659]]
